captions.detailed: A bicycle floor pump featuring a vertical grey steel barrel mounted on a wide black rectangular base. A thin black hose runs down the side of the barrel, and a circular pressure gauge with a white face and a dark needle is attached near the bottom. At the top, a horizontal T-handle with black grips is attached to a metallic piston rod. One of the handle grips is designed as a folding sleeve that can rotate around the crossbar axis, while the entire handle and piston assembly can slide vertically along the barrel axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a bicycle track floor pump. Include a wide rectangular base, a vertical cylindrical barrel, a circular pressure gauge near the base, a side hose, and a T-handle connected to a central piston rod. Make the piston rod and handle assembly slide vertically (prismatic joint), the pressure gauge needle rotate on its pivot, and one of the handle grips rotate continuously around the crossbar.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base and a vertical cylinder for the pump barrel using box and cylinder primitives. A side hose is modeled with a thin, long vertical cylinder, and a circular gauge is created with concentric cylinders for the housing and dial face, plus a thin box for the needle. The piston rod is a vertical cylinder extending from the top, capped with a horizontal cross-cylinder for the T-handle. One side of the handle features a sleeve cylinder representing a folding grip. Prismatic, revolute, and continuous joints are defined to govern the vertical motion of the piston, the rotation of the gauge needle, and the rotation of the folding grip sleeve.
